ENGINEERING LETTER
Re: Structural and Seismic Analysis — 123 Main Street High-rise Project
Date: 2024-02-10
Engineer of Record: J. Smith, PE
The referenced structure has been analyzed for seismic demands in accordance
with the California Building Code 2022, Chapter 16. The seismic design
category is confirmed as Category D based on site class and mapped spectral
values. The primary lateral system consists of concrete shear walls designed
to resist code-level seismic forces. All referenced standards are current
adopted versions. This letter presents findings for engineer review.
Governing reference: CBC-2022 seismic provisions.
